title: [Market of Lost Things, Hold]
description: The floor of the hold is formed from salvaged decking arranged in tight squares over grating that drains to the bilge.  A handful of permanent stalls line the curved walls, framed by iron struts wrapped in hemp rope, while the central aisle remains open for handcarts and barrows.  Folding canopies of patched sailcloth stretch from beam to beam, allowing the market spaces to reconfigure as needed.
